name: Millicom International Cellular S.A.
moat_justification: Leading local scale, spectrum and fiber assets give a real but narrow moat: gross margins are high and rising and ROIC has inflected to 12-15% in 2024-25, but ROIC ran at 4.5-7.7% through 2020-2023, the customer base is low-ARPU prepaid, and Claro contests nearly every market — a 5, not a 7.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 6.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-24), cover page Section 12(b) table: 'Common Shares, par value $1.50 per share', trading symbol TIGO, The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC; Item 12.D (American Depositary Shares) is 'None - Not Applicable'; the cover states 169,000,000 common shares outstanding as of December 31, 2025) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.4x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.5%) vs bull-case tier C (12.2%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Solid LatAm telecom franchise, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $82.87 (weighted IRR 9.6%, IV@15% $46.70; clears 15% only below ~$46.70) — even the super-bull only just clears, and the FY2025 base predates the 2026 Colombia perimeter.
moat_for: Leading (#1/#2) mobile and fixed positions across nine Latin American markets, with spectrum licenses and a fiber footprint of about 14 million homes passed
Gross margin high and rising: 71.9% in FY2021 to 77.5% in FY2025 (fundamentals.json)
ROIC proxy inflected to 12.2% in FY2024 and 15.0% in FY2025 on the efficiency program (fundamentals.json roic_proxy)
Scale in each local market plus Tigo Money and Tigo Business (cloud, security, data center) attach on the same customer base
moat_against: ROIC proxy was only 4.5-7.7% in 2020-2023 — at or below the cost of capital through most of the cycle; the 2024-25 step-up is two years old
America Movil (Claro) competes in nearly every market with deeper pockets
Low-income prepaid base: mobile ARPU $6.2/month in FY2025 — limited pricing power, high churn
FX and political exposure (Bolivia dollar shortage, Colombian regulation) plus high leverage limits reinvestment flexibility
Capex intensity rising on the acquired perimeter (H1 2026 capex +48.8% YoY as reported)
